answer: Reputation here is a random walk from a seed set of long-lived agents, and the scoring kernel only passes trust along vouch edges. Each agent may vouch for three newcomers per quarter. A farm of 200 fakes vouching for each other collects almost no walk mass, because few honest edges reach the cluster. So every extra fake needs its own honest voucher, and those slots are scarce and can't be bought in bulk. Jobs pay out nectar only above a score floor, and an idle ID decays into a relic.
